n05331.label: HPA-axis glucocorticoid secretion and circadian clock
n05331.link: SCN/BMAL1:CLOCK clock gates the diurnal ACTH-cortisol rhythm, and glucocorticoids in turn reset peripheral clocks
misfit_examples: regulation of type B pancreatic cell proliferation
NPAS4 regulates expression of target genes

n06718.label: Non-vesicular lipid transfer at ER-Golgi contacts
misfit_examples: RAB GEFs exchange GTP for GDP on RABs

n02788.label: IGF signalling in bone and cartilage mineralization
n02788.link: GH/IGF-1 via IGF1R drives growth-plate chondrocyte maturation and osteoblast bone mineralization

n05981.label: Protein lysine/arginine acetylation and methylation
n05981.link: lysine residues (histones, p53) are competing substrates for acetyltransferases and methyltransferases; methionine supplies the SAM methyl donor

n08070.label: PI3K-AKT-PTEN and inositol pyrophosphate signalling
n08070.link: IP6K-made inositol pyrophosphate IP7 competes with PIP3 for the AKT PH domain; NUDT/DIPP hydrolases degrade both diphosphoinositol polyphosphates and diadenosine polyphosphates

n05553.label: Histone acetylation and nucleosome/CENP-A assembly
n05553.link: HAT1 acetylates new histone H4 K5/K12 before replication-dependent deposition; histone chaperone-mediated nucleosome and CENP-A deposition

n01458.label: PTEN-PI3K regulation and inositol pyrophosphates
n01458.link: lncRNA/ceRNA control of PTEN translation and IP7 competition with PIP3 for AKT both tune PI3K-AKT output; NUDT hydrolases degrade PP-InsPs and Ap(n)A

n06941.label: TGF-beta control of fibroblasts, ECM and miRNAs
n06941.link: TGF-beta/SMAD2/3 drives fibroblast ECM programmes and binds the Drosha/p68 complex to promote pri-miR-21 processing; miRNAs (miR-21, miR-29) regulate fibrosis

n05764.label: Thyroid hormone and large neutral amino acid transport
n05764.link: T3/T4 cross membranes via LAT1/LAT2 (SLC7A5/SLC7A8) and MCT10 (SLC16A10), the same transporters for leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine and tryptophan

n05857.label: MAPK and IL-6 signalling with DUSP feedback
n05857.link: immediate-early DUSPs (e.g. DUSP1) dephosphorylate Thr/Tyr on ERK/p38/JNK as negative feedback; IL-6/STAT3 and AP-1/NR4A are co-induced immediate-early programmes

n07899.label: Ca2+-activated scrambling, mechanosensing and ATP release
n07899.link: mechanical/osmotic stress (PIEZO1) raises Ca2+, activating TMEM16F/ANO6 scrambling, blebbing and membrane repair, and ATP release via connexin/pannexin channels hydrolysed by NTPDases

n05808.label: Fat-soluble vitamins, steroid hormones, mineral homeostasis
n05808.link: vitamin D/PTH/NaPi-II axis controls phosphate for bone and enamel, vitamin K gamma-carboxylates osteocalcin/MGP, and vitamin D is a secosteroid hydroxylated by CYP enzymes like sex steroids
misfit_examples: obsolete renal system process involved in regulation of blood volume

n02530.label: Transcriptional control of the cadherin switch
n02530.link: EMT TFs (SNAIL/ZEB/TWIST) bind E-box promoters to repress CDH1 and induce CDH11; ID proteins block DNA binding of E-proteins
misfit_examples: negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription initiation

n02199.label: Stromal fibroblast ECM and adhesion programme
n02199.link: RAS-ERK-induced FOSL1/AP-1 drives ECM, MMP and adhesion genes in mesenchymal/stromal cells
misfit_examples: myeloid cell cytokines, metallopeptidases and laminins

n05841.label: TGF-beta/activin receptor signalling and SMAD partners
n05841.link: RUNX3 and FOXO are SMAD3 partners that together induce CDKN1A (p21) in TGF-beta growth arrest; TGFBR3 and follistatin modulate TGF-beta/activin ligand access

n02674.label: Scavenger receptors: efferocytosis and oxLDL uptake
n02674.link: CD36, SR-A and SR-BI recognise oxidised phospholipid/PS on apoptotic cells and on oxLDL, driving both corpse clearance and foam-cell formation

n06777.label: Pancreatobiliary and endocrine lineage development
n06777.link: shared PDX1/SOX9/NOTCH-HES1 progenitor programme gives ductal, biliary and NEUROG3+ endocrine lineages

n07778.label: p53/mTORC1 control of glycolysis and PPP
n07778.link: p53 target TIGAR lowers fructose-2,6-bisphosphate to divert glucose from glycolysis to the pentose-phosphate shunt; mTORC1/PGC-1alpha regulate glycolytic and oxidative genes
misfit_examples: regulation of SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process

n07543.label: tRNA processing and mitochondrial gene expression
n07543.link: mitochondrial RNase P (TRMT10C/HSD17B10/PRORP) and ELAC2 excise mt-tRNAs punctuating polycistronic mt transcripts; tRNA processing/modification enzymes are shared or dual-localised
misfit_examples: rRNA modification in the nucleus and cytosol

n08182.label: Pluripotency, early lineages and placentation
n08182.link: OCT4/SOX2/NANOG maintain ICM/epiblast and primordial germ cells while repressing CDX2-driven trophectoderm that forms trophoblast/placenta
misfit_examples: obsolete negative regulation of transcription by competitive promoter binding

n06710.label: Myelination and node of Ranvier organisation
n06710.link: neurofascin/NrCAM/L1-CAMs anchor to ankyrin-G at nodes and paranodes; Schwann cell connexin-32 gap junctions in myelin (CMTX)

n08012.label: Renin-angiotensin, vasopressin and osmotic fluid balance
n08012.link: angiotensin II stimulates aldosterone and vasopressin release to retain salt and water; natriuretic peptide cGMP opposes; renal epithelial chloride transport executes it
misfit_examples: negative regulation of pancreatic juice secretion

n08532.label: Endocrine and neuroendocrine organ development
n08532.link: shared neuroendocrine TFs (PAX6, ISL1, NEUROD1, NKX2-2) in islets, adenohypophysis and forebrain; pancreas and stomach arise from foregut endoderm
misfit_examples: POU5F1 (OCT4), SOX2, NANOG activate genes related to proliferation

n07992.label: Broad genome maintenance and stress grab-bag

n08119.label: Ca2+/mechanical membrane signals: ATP release, PS exposure
n08119.link: Apoptotic and stressed cells release ATP via pannexin-1 as a P2Y 'find-me' signal (hydrolysed by NTPDases) and expose PS via TMEM16F/ANO6 Ca2+-activated scrambling as an 'eat-me' signal; PIEZO1 Ca2+ influx under shear drives both ATP release and TMEM16F scrambling

n04189.label: Vitamin A and D hormone metabolism
n04189.link: Both are fat-soluble vitamin-derived nuclear-receptor ligands (RAR/VDR, each heterodimerising with RXR) whose activation/inactivation is controlled by cytochrome P450s (CYP27B1/CYP24A1 for calcitriol, CYP26 for retinoic acid)

n07273.label: Axonal ER shaping and microtubule organelle transport
n07273.link: Hereditary spastic paraplegia/motor neuron genes: atlastin (ER fusion), REEP1 (membrane bending), spastin (microtubule severing, endosome tubulation) and KIF5A/Miro (RHOT) mitochondrial axonal transport maintain long corticospinal axons

n07119.label: Epithelial polarized trafficking, CFTR and organelle acidification
n07119.link: V-ATPase-driven Golgi/endosomal acidification is required for polarized apical/basolateral sorting of cargo such as CFTR; CFTR/anion conductance supplies counter-ions for luminal acidification and drives transepithelial fluid transport

n06429.label: PLP-dependent sulfur amino acid metabolism and cofactors
n06429.link: Pyridoxal phosphate is the cofactor of CBS/CSE in transsulfuration and H2S production and of serine dehydratase; sulfide oxidation to sulfate ends with molybdenum-cofactor sulfite oxidase

n08406.label: Hepatic mitochondrial amino acid and amine catabolism
n08406.link: Threonine and choline catabolism (via betaine/sarcosine) yield glycine that mitochondrial glycine N-acyltransferase uses to conjugate benzoate/salicylate; choline and carnitine are trimethylammonium compounds, histidine/choline feed one-carbon pools

n04436.label: Cellular Na+/K+ and pH homeostasis
n04436.link: Na+/K+-ATPase (cardiac glycoside target) sets the Na+ gradient that drives NHE proton extrusion; carbonic anhydrase supplies H+/HCO3-; V-ATPase acidifies organelles with NHE6/9 as counter-leak

n05310.label: Neural crest-derived enteric and sympathoadrenal development
n05310.link: RET/GDNF and endothelin-3/EDNRB are jointly required for enteric neural crest migration (Hirschsprung disease); neural crest also forms sympathetic ganglia and adrenal medulla making catecholamines

n05847.label: Nephron glomerular and brush-border epithelial development
n05847.link: Glomerular filtration barrier (podocyte nephrin, mesangial cells) and proximal-tubule brush border are nephron epithelial specialisations; podocalyxin/NHERF2/ezrin apical actin scaffold is shared by podocytes and microvilli
misfit_examples: Developmental Lineage of Pancreatic Ductal Cells
Developmental Lineage of Pancreatic Endocrine Mid Progenitor Cells

n05486.label: Acetyl-CoA production with NAD+ and CoA cofactors
n05486.link: Pyruvate dehydrogenase requires CoA (from pantothenate) and NAD+ (from salvage), and its lipoate cofactor is made by mitochondrial fatty acid synthesis from malonyl-CoA producing octanoyl chains

n07092.label: HPA stress axis and neuroendocrine behaviour
n07092.link: Hypothalamic CRH-ACTH-cortisol axis with glucocorticoid feedback mediates stress responses, and hypothalamic neuropeptides (CRH, vasopressin, oxytocin) modulate fear, aggression, drinking, wakefulness and social/parental behaviour

n06223.label: TCA cycle metabolites and HIF oxygen sensing
n06223.link: 2-oxoglutarate is the co-substrate of PHD prolyl hydroxylases that degrade HIF-alpha; succinate, fumarate and 2-hydroxyglutarate inhibit PHDs causing pseudohypoxia

n03983.label: MET and ERBB2 receptor tyrosine kinase signalling
n03983.link: MET and ERBB2 share adaptors GRB2, GAB1 and GRB7 to activate PI3K/AKT, RAS and PTK2/PTK6 downstream

n05837.label: Neuropeptide GPCR control of sleep and reproduction
n05837.link: Hypothalamic neuropeptides acting on GPCRs: orexin drives wakefulness/REM regulation, oxytocin (and relaxin) control uterine contraction, parturition, mating and maternal behaviour

n04321.label: Mitochondrial adenine nucleotide and NAD+ handling
n04321.link: Mitochondrial SLC25 carriers exchange ATP/ADP (ANT) and import NAD+ (SLC25A51); ANT is coupled to mitochondrial creatine kinase for phosphocreatine and is targeted by HIV Vpr and influenza PB1-F2 to trigger MOMP

n02812.label: TYK2-dependent IFN and IL-10/IL-12 family cytokines
n02812.link: Type III IFNs (IL-28/29) belong to the IL-10 family sharing IL-10R2; type I IFN, IL-10 family and IL-12/IL-23 receptors all signal through TYK2

n08382.label: Nucleotide and inositol pyrophosphate phosphoanhydride turnover
n08382.link: Nudix DIPP hydrolases (NUDT3/4/10/11) cleave both diphosphoinositol polyphosphates and diadenosine polyphosphates; IP6K/PPIP5K and NDPK/adenylate kinase transfer ATP phosphoanhydride groups

n05083.label: Limbic synaptic transmission and behaviour
n05083.link: Glutamatergic/GABAergic synapses in amygdala and hippocampus underlie exploratory, anxiety-like and psychomotor behaviours; kainate receptor overactivation causes hippocampal excitotoxic neuron death; NCAM regulates these synapses

n08517.label: Transepithelial anion and water transport
n08517.link: SLC26 anion exchangers (SLC26A3/A6/A4) create osmotic gradients that aquaporins follow in gut, kidney proximal tubule and inner ear; SLC26A3 loss causes watery chloride diarrhoea; lens transparency relies on AQP0 and gap-junction fluid circulation

n04346.label: Heterogeneous housekeeping: DNA, RNA, mitochondria, trafficking
misfit_examples: Budding and maturation of HIV virion

n05613.label: Mitochondrial gene expression and respiratory chain biogenesis
n05613.link: Mitochondrial transcription/translation produce core OXPHOS subunits whose assembly needs heme A, Fe-S clusters and ubiquinone cofactors made by the same organelle
misfit_examples: Uptake and function of diphtheria toxin
Synthesis of wybutosine at G37 of tRNA(Phe)

n06994.label: Hypothalamic neuropeptide GPCR control of feeding/sleep
n06994.link: Hypothalamic peptide hormones (CRH, relaxin-3, calcitonin/amylin, somatostatin) act via Gs/Gi-coupled GPCRs that tune cAMP/PKA in hypothalamic circuits governing feeding, sleep/wake, stress and reproductive behaviour

n06799.label: Specialised modifications of translation machinery
n06799.link: Unusual residue/nucleotide modifications of translation components tune elongation and termination fidelity: hypusine on eIF5A, diphthamide on eEF2 (diphtheria toxin target), wybutosine in tRNA-Phe, selenocysteine tRNA, and 2-oxoglutarate oxygenase hydroxylation of eRF1/RPS23 affecting readthrough

n07468.label: Phosphate/vitamin D axis and mitochondrial P450s
n07468.link: Mitochondrial cytochrome P450s (CYP11A1 for pregnenolone/glucocorticoids, CYP27B1/CYP24A1 for vitamin D) share the adrenodoxin reductase-adrenodoxin (NADPH-ferredoxin) electron chain; vitamin D, PTH and FGF23-FGFR (FAM20C-phosphorylated) regulate Na+/Pi cotransport and mineralisation

n02864.label: Golgi O-glycosylation of dystroglycan and proteoglycans
n02864.link: Both are protein O-glycosylation pathways building extracellular-matrix-binding glycans; LARGE1 makes xylose-glucuronic acid matriglycan on alpha-dystroglycan, analogous to the xylose-initiated GAG linkage region (XYLT/B4GALT7/B3GALT6/B3GAT3) of proteoglycans

n06541.label: Osmotic stress, magnesium transport, oligomerisation
n06541.link: none (only inositol uptake via SMIT as an osmolyte links inositol to hyperosmotic response; magnesium transport and generic protein oligomerisation terms have no specific connection)

n06859.label: Immediate-early AP-1 response in liver regeneration
n06859.link: TNF/NF-kB and growth-factor/RAS signals induce immediate-early genes (FOS/JUN AP-1, NR4A, EGR1) in the priming phase of liver regeneration, driving hepatocyte proliferation and survival

n05428.label: MECP2 chromatin regulation and Rett-like neurobehaviour
n05428.link: MECP2 binds 5mC/5hmC and recruits NCoR/SMRT-HDAC3 repressors; its loss (Rett syndrome, mouse models) produces motor, sensory-gating (prepulse inhibition), vocalisation and striatal/amygdala phenotypes
misfit_examples: adenylate cyclase-inhibiting G protein-coupled glutamate receptor signaling pathway
negative regulation of voltage-gated calcium channel activity

n05134.label: Hypothalamic stress axis and motivated behaviour
n05134.link: Hypothalamic neuropeptides (CRH driving ACTH-cortisol in the HPA axis, orexin, QRFP/NPFF) act via GPCRs to coordinate stress responses, arousal/sleep and reproductive/parental behaviour
misfit_examples: positive regulation of transmission of nerve impulse

n05638.label: MET/RON and TGF-beta receptor signalling
n05638.link: none (two distinct receptor systems; only a general cancer/EMT association, no shared mechanism)
misfit_examples: SMAD2/3 MH2 Domain Mutants in Cancer

n05357.label: Class B GPCR-cAMP control of growth hormone axis
n05357.link: GHRH acts via a glucagon-family class B GPCR (Gs-cAMP) to drive GH secretion, opposed by somatostatin (Gi), with GH-IGF1 setting growth rate; calcitonin/CGRP/amylin receptors are related class B GPCRs signalling via cAMP
misfit_examples: calcitonin gene-related peptide receptor signaling pathway

n06268.label: Proteasome, antigen presentation and PD-L1 turnover
n06268.link: Proteasome generates MHC-I peptides for CD8 T cell recognition (incl. cross-presentation), and proteasomal/ERAD degradation of PD-L1 (GSK3B, SPOP, AMPK) controls T cell antitumour responses

n07782.label: Ocular vascular development and barrier formation
n07782.link: Norrin/WNT-FZD4-LRP5 signalling builds retinal vessels and the blood-retina/blood-brain barrier, and macrophage WNT7b-induced endothelial apoptosis regresses the hyaloid vasculature; eye development depends on these vessels

n06741.label: Actin-bundle apical protrusions: microvilli and stereocilia
n06741.link: Brush border microvilli and hair cell stereocilia are parallel actin bundle protrusions built by homologous machinery (Usher complex harmonin/MYO7, protocadherin links, espin); podocyte foot processes are polarised actin-based epithelial specialisations

n03063.label: Microglial clearance of apoptotic neurons
n03063.link: Microglia recognise phosphatidylserine on apoptotic neurons (e.g. after kainate excitotoxicity) via receptors such as TREM2/MERTK and engulf them (efferocytosis), with activation/proliferation coupled to clearance

n08555.label: Heterogeneous BTMs plus nucleocytoplasmic transport
n08555.link: none (unnamed housekeeping BTMs and PAX3 motif set have no specific link to nuclear import/export regulation)

n06564.label: Receptor PTP regulation of protein phosphorylation
n06564.link: Receptor protein tyrosine phosphatases mediate homophilic adhesion and are regulated by ectodomain shedding while controlling dephosphorylation

n07033.label: MET/EGFR signalling via PTK6 and STAT3
n07033.link: PTK6 (BRK) and SRC act downstream of MET/EGFR to activate STAT3 and RAS/RAC pathways

n07443.label: Epithelial-mesenchymal branching organ morphogenesis
n07443.link: Shared FGF10-FGFR2b, SHH and BMP4 epithelial-mesenchymal signalling drives branching of lung, mammary, prostate and pancreatic buds; hedgehog/androgen signalling also patterns Leydig cells and male genitalia

n08390.label: Adipocyte lipolysis, glycerol export and thermogenesis
n08390.link: Cold-induced thermogenesis drives adipocyte lipolysis releasing fatty acids (FATP transport, UCP1 fatty-acid cycling, PM20D1 N-acyl amino acids like oleoyl-Phe) and glycerol via aquaglyceroporin AQP7/AQP9 (which also carry urea); HCA receptors feed back to inhibit lipolysis

n02885.label: Craniofacial and limb morphogenesis
n02885.link: Limb buds and facial prominences share outgrowth/patterning signals (SHH, FGF8, BMP, MSX/DLX/TBX) and are co-affected in acrofacial syndromes

n07848.label: Stress granules and mRNA stabilisation
n07848.link: Arsenite/PKR-induced eIF2alpha phosphorylation nucleates stress granules that sequester mRNA-stabilising RBPs (G3BP, IGF2BPs, CRD-mediated stabilisation)

n06653.label: Sphingolipid synthesis, transfer and turnover
n06653.link: Ceramide-centred sphingolipid metabolism: synthesis, nonvesicular transfer (GLTP, CPTP, CERT) and lysosomal degradation

n05811.label: AID/APOBEC cytidine deamination and uracil repair
n05811.link: AID/APOBEC cytidine deaminases convert C to U in Ig genes (somatic hypermutation), retroviral minus-strand DNA (APOBEC3 restriction of HIV) and apoB mRNA (APOBEC1 editosome); resulting uracils are processed by base excision/mismatch repair
misfit_examples: negative regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, nonsense-mediated decay

n07993.label: Host RNA processing, translation and viral replication
n07993.link: Viruses (HIV, SARS-CoV-2) depend on host transcription (Tat-P-TEFb elongation), RNA processing, nuclear export and translation machinery, which form one gene-expression system with rRNA/tRNA/mRNA processing

n04214.label: Mitochondrial gene expression and OXPHOS
n04214.link: mtDNA-encoded OXPHOS subunits require mitochondrial transcription, modified mt-tRNA/rRNA and mitoribosome translation; several tRNA-modifying enzymes (e.g. PUS1, TRMT family) act in both nuclear and mitochondrial tRNA

n06628.label: Cation channels, transporters and cell-volume osmoregulation
n06628.link: Tetrameric K+ and TRP channels plus Na/K/Cl cotransporters set cell volume; myo-inositol is an osmolyte; claudin paracellular pathway reabsorbs Mg2+/Na+

n04043.label: Hypothalamic control of feeding, stress and growth
n04043.link: Leptin acts on arcuate POMC/AgRP neurons controlling feeding and the HPA (CRH-ACTH-cortisol) axis; relaxin-3/RXFP3 is a hypothalamic orexigenic, stress-modulating peptide

n05270.label: HPA stress axis with growth and feeding control
n05270.link: CRH-R1 (Gs-cAMP/PKA) drives ACTH and glucocorticoid release; glucocorticoids/CRH suppress GH-IGF growth and food intake
misfit_examples: regulation of locomotion involved in locomotory behavior

n03373.label: Nutrient/stress repression of rRNA transcription
n03373.link: SIRT1/eNoSC silences nucleolar rDNA chromatin and mTORC1 (methionine/SAM sensing) controls Pol I ribosome biogenesis, coupled to quiescence
misfit_examples: TFAP2A acts as a transcriptional repressor during retinoic acid induced cell differentiation

n05303.label: Hypothalamic appetite and POMC-HPA regulation
n05303.link: POMC is cleaved to alpha-MSH (MC4R satiety) and ACTH (cortisol); leptin acts on POMC neurons; POMC/ACTH defects cause obesity and adrenal insufficiency
misfit_examples: regulation of locomotion involved in locomotory behavior

n02442.label: Ceramide signalling in apoptosis
n02442.link: TNFR1 activates sphingomyelinases producing pro-apoptotic ceramide
misfit_examples: cellular response to insulin-like growth factor stimulus
response to insulin-like growth factor stimulus

n05944.label: Endocrine FGF-Klotho and vitamin D axis
n05944.link: FGF23 via FGFR1c/alpha-Klotho represses CYP27B1 and induces CYP24A1, while calcitriol induces FGF23; FGF19/21 use betaKlotho with FGFR4/FGFR1c

n03705.label: TFAP2 and RUNX transcription factor programs
misfit_examples: Activation of the TFAP2 (AP-2) family of transcription factors
TFAP2 (AP-2) family regulates transcription of other transcription factors

n04357.label: Sulfur/selenium amino acid and glutathione metabolism
n04357.link: PLP-dependent CBS/CTH transsulfuration makes cysteine for glutathione (GST aflatoxin conjugation) and Moco sulfur; SeMet/Sec use the same enzymes

n05922.label: Immediate-early stress gene response
n05922.link: UV, PMA, NO and TNF converge on p38/JNK/NF-kB to induce immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1, NR4A, ATF3)

n07467.label: Organelle acidification and SLC ion transporter disorders
n07467.link: V-ATPase acidifies endosomes/lysosomes/Golgi while NHE6 (SLC9A6) leaks H+ to set endosomal pH; SLC34/SLC24A4/SLC26 transport ions for mineralization

n08073.label: Thyroid hormone activation and selenoproteins
n08073.link: Iodothyronine deiodinases DIO1-3 are selenocysteine enzymes needing UGA recoding; GPx selenoproteins clear H2O2 used by thyroid peroxidase
misfit_examples: regulation of hepatic stellate cell activation

n05112.label: Protein lipidation (palmitoylation, prenylation)
n05112.link: none between protein S-acylation/prenylation and GLTP/CPTP glycolipid transfer

n06321.label: Eye and inner-ear sensory epithelium development
n06321.link: Usher genes (MYO7A, USH1C, CDH23, PCDH15) build hair-cell stereocilia (modified microvilli) and photoreceptor structures; shared retina/hair-cell degeneration

n02468.label: Magnesium transport via tight junctions and channels
n02468.link: Claudin-16/19 tight junctions form a paracellular Mg2+ pore in the thick ascending limb; tetrameric TRPM6/7 carry transcellular Mg2+

n04479.label: IL-1 family and IL-17 inflammatory axis
n04479.link: IL-18/IL-36 (IL-1 family) promote Th17/IL-17 production and IL-38 antagonizes IL-36R; IL-17 induces CXCL1 (psoriasis axis)

n08766.label: Small GTPase regulation in lymphocytes
n08766.link: DEF6 is a Rac/Cdc42 GEF acting with CORO1A on actin; RHOH and Ral GTPases control trafficking and surface protein delivery

n00795.label: Y-linked spermatogenesis and histone crotonylation
n00795.link: Y-linked testis-specific CDY genes (and paralog CDYL) are crotonyl-CoA hydratases that regulate histone crotonylation in spermatogenesis

n07161.label: HGF/MET and Hippo-YAP growth control
n07161.link: HGF/MET mitogenic signalling and Hippo-YAP density sensing jointly control hepatocyte proliferation and liver size in regeneration

n03010.label: Angiogenesis and vascular wound repair
n03010.link: VEGF/VEGFR2 drives endothelial migration and tube formation in wound neovascularization, with fibroblast FGF/TGF-beta2 repair signals

n07537.label: P450/lipoxygenase oxidation of fatty acids and eicosanoids
n07537.link: CYP4/CYP2 omega-hydroxylases and epoxygenases, TBXAS1 (CYP5A1) and LOX/hepoxilin pathways oxidize arachidonate; CYP4F22 and FATP4 supply skin-barrier lipids

n03134.label: SUMOylation and nuclear pore complex
n03134.link: RanBP2/Nup358 is a SUMO E3 anchoring SUMO-RanGAP1:UBC9 at the NPC; SENP desumoylases localize to nuclear pores

n08734.label: Cholinergic transmission and K+ channel control
n08734.link: Nicotinic AChRs mediate neuromuscular transmission; muscarinic M2 activates GIRK and Gq-coupled muscarinic receptors inhibit TASK channels

n03423.label: Platelet activation, coagulation and eicosanoids
n03423.link: Platelet cPLA2 releases arachidonate for COX-1/TBXAS1 thromboxane A2 and 12-LOX products, amplifying platelet-driven coagulation
